cards.name: IVGCommentThread
cards.summary: One review-comment thread from CorelDRAW's Comments docker: the opening comment plus its replies, pinned to a target on a page, with an open / resolved / reopened status and an on-canvas annotation marker.
use_for: resolving every addressed client comment before final print handoff
auto-replying to or logging proof feedback per page
exporting a who-said-what review log for a job folder
avoid: setting Status directly: it is read-only, call Resolve or Reopen
carrying production data in comments: they are review markup, not artwork; use Shape.ObjectData instead
cards.how: Wrapper for one thread in a document's review markup. Reach it per page with ActivePage.Markup.Threads(i) (IVGPageMarkup.Threads), by GUID with ActiveDocument.Markup.FindThread(guid), or from a comment's Thread. A new thread starts when a page-markup Create... call (CreateHotspot, CreateRectangle ...) adds its first comment. Comments holds the opening comment and the replies; Reply adds one, Resolve / Reopen change Status, Delete removes the whole thread.

key_members.name: Target
key_members.use: IVGCommentTarget the thread is pinned to (its Shape / Guid)

key_members.name: Comments
key_members.use: IVGComments: the opening comment first, then the replies

key_members.name: Status
key_members.use: read-only cdrCommentStatus: Open 0, Resolved 1, Reopened 2

key_members.name: Reply
key_members.use: Reply(Text, [Author]) adds a reply and returns the new IVGComment

key_members.name: Resolve
key_members.use: marks the thread resolved, optionally as a given Author

key_members.name: Reopen
key_members.use: reopens a resolved thread (Status becomes Reopened, not Open)

key_members.name: Delete
key_members.use: removes the thread with all its replies

key_members.name: PageMarkup
key_members.use: IVGPageMarkup of the page the thread sits on

key_members.name: Annotation
key_members.use: IVGCommentAnnotation: the on-canvas marker (hotspot, rectangle, arrow ...) and its geometry

gotchas: A reopened thread reports cdrCommentStatusReopened (2), not Open (0); test Status <> cdrCommentStatusResolved when you mean 'still needs work'
Author is optional on Reply / Resolve / Reopen; when omitted the action is credited to the current or default comment author (unverified)
Comment markers are not shapes: they do not appear in Page.Shapes and do not print or export as artwork (unverified)
Threads synced through cloud collaboration also carry an online ID; look those up with Markup.FindThreadByOnlineID, not FindThread (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim t As Object
For Each t In ActivePage.Markup.Threads
  If t.Status <> cdrCommentStatusResolved Then
    t.Reply "Fixed in v2"
    t.Resolve
  End If
Next t

review.changes: none

cards.name: IVGCommentThreads
cards.summary: Read-only collection of the comment threads on one page's review markup, indexed by number or thread GUID; used to walk every review comment on a page.
use_for: counting open review comments per page before sign-off
building a page-by-page review report
fetching a known thread by GUID on a given page
avoid: searching the whole document for one GUID page by page: ActiveDocument.Markup.FindThread does it in one call
trying to add threads here: there is no Add; start one with a page-markup Create... call
cards.how: Returned by IVGPageMarkup.Threads (ActivePage.Markup.Threads, or ActiveDocument.Pages(i).Markup.Threads). Enumerate with For Each, or call Item with an index (presumably 1-based) or a GUID string; First / Last are shortcuts.

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: Item(IndexOrGuid): a thread by index (presumably 1-based, unverified) or GUID string (default member)

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: enables For Each over the page's threads

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of threads on the page

key_members.name: First
key_members.use: first thread on the page

key_members.name: Last
key_members.use: last (usually newest) thread on the page (unverified ordering)

gotchas: The collection is per page; for a document-wide count loop ActiveDocument.Pages and read each page's Markup.Threads
First / Last on a page with no comments likely raise an error; check Count first (unverified)
Includes resolved threads; filter on each thread's Status
cards.example:
Dim p As Object, n As Long
For Each p In ActiveDocument.Pages
  n = n + p.Markup.Threads.Count
Next p
MsgBox n & " comment threads"

review.changes: Item / how no longer state 1-based indexing as fact: the typelib gives no base for this collection (marked presumably, unverified)

cards.name: IVGComponent
cards.summary: One CorelDRAW component (presumably a feature module or add-on) identified only by its ComponentID string; the typelib gives it no description and no other members, so what a given ID provides is not documented here.
use_for: listing the component IDs present on a workstation
finding the ComponentID to pass to Document.CustomCommand / Shape.CustomCommand
avoid: checking for one known component: Components.IsComponentInstalled(id) answers directly
expecting a name, version or enabled flag: only ComponentID exists
cards.how: Item of a Components collection: Application.Components (application-specific, per the typelib) or ActiveDocument.Components (document-specific), by index or name. Its only member, ComponentID, is the string the CustomCommand(ComponentID, CommandID, Parameters) methods on IVGDocument and IVGShape take first.

key_members.name: ComponentID
key_members.use: read-only identifier string of the component; feed it to CustomCommand

gotchas: No description in the typelib; the meaning of each ComponentID and the CommandIDs it accepts are not exposed by the API (unverified)
IDs may be GUID-like strings rather than readable feature names (unverified); print them before relying on one
cards.example:
Dim c As Object
For Each c In Application.Components
  Debug.Print c.ComponentID
Next c

review.changes: how: Application.Components is 'application-specific components' per the typelib, not 'installed'; summary's feature-module/add-on reading marked as presumed

cards.name: IVGComponents
cards.summary: Collection of CorelDRAW components (presumably feature modules / add-ons), at application level or per document, with a direct test of whether a given component ID is installed.
use_for: guarding a macro that depends on an optional add-on before calling CustomCommand
inventorying installed modules on studio machines
avoid: assuming component IDs are human-readable feature names: list ComponentID values first
cards.how: Application.Components (described as the application-specific components) or ActiveDocument.Components (described as the document-specific components). Item takes an index or a name; IsComponentInstalled(ComponentID) answers True/False without enumerating.

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: For Each over the components

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: Item(IndexOrName): one IVGComponent

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of components in the collection

key_members.name: IsComponentInstalled
key_members.use: IsComponentInstalled(ComponentID) -> True if that component is installed

gotchas: Item's 'name' key is not documented; it is probably the ComponentID string (unverified)
Document.Components and Application.Components can differ; check the one the CustomCommand call runs against (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim id As String
id = Application.Components(1).ComponentID
If Application.Components.IsComponentInstalled(id) Then
  Debug.Print id & " is installed"
End If

review.changes: how: Application.Components is described as application-specific components, not 'everything installed'; summary's add-on reading marked as presumed

cards.name: IVGConnector
cards.summary: Geometry of a connector-line shape (Connector tool): its start and end snap points and its routing type (straight, right-angle, B-spline, Bezier or object). The line stays attached when the connected objects move.
use_for: flowcharts and org charts whose lines follow the boxes
process, wiring and assembly diagrams in technical illustration
linking callout labels to parts so they survive re-layout
avoid: plain arrows that must not stay attached: draw a curve with an arrowhead instead
freely shaped decorative lines: this API exposes only the two end snap points and a read-only Type, no node editing; draw a curve instead
cards.how: Shape.Connector on a shape whose Type is cdrConnectorShape. Create one with ActiveLayer.CreateConnector(Start, End) or CreateConnectorEx(Type, Start, End), passing IVGSnapPoint objects (from Shape.SnapPointsOfType, or ActiveDocument.CreateFreeSnapPoint for a loose end). Reassign StartPoint / EndPoint to re-route it to other objects.

key_members.name: StartPoint
key_members.use: IVGSnapPoint the connector starts at (read/write: assign another snap point to re-attach)

key_members.name: EndPoint
key_members.use: IVGSnapPoint the connector ends at (read/write)

key_members.name: Type
key_members.use: read-only cdrConnectorType: Straight 0, RightAngle 1, BSpline 2, Bezier 3, Object 4

gotchas: Type is read-only; to change straight to right-angle, create a new connector with CreateConnectorEx (unverified)
Shape.Connector is only meaningful when Shape.Type = cdrConnectorShape; on other shapes it errors or returns Nothing (unverified)
Ends are snap points, not coordinates: read a position via StartPoint.PositionX / PositionY
cards.example:
Dim s As Shape
Set s = ActiveLayer.CreateConnectorEx(cdrConnectorRightAngle, _
  ActiveDocument.CreateFreeSnapPoint(1, 1), ActiveDocument.CreateFreeSnapPoint(4, 3))
Debug.Print s.Connector.Type, s.Connector.EndPoint.PositionX

review.changes: avoid: replaced the unsupported 'path driven by type, not editable nodes' claim with what the API actually exposes

cards.name: IVGCrossPoint
cards.summary: One intersection between two paths, as returned by SubPath.GetIntersections or Segment.GetIntersections: its X/Y position and how far along each of the two paths it lies.
use_for: marking where two paths cross for over-under knotwork or weaves
splitting or adding a node exactly at a crossing
placing rivets, dots or labels at line intersections in technical drawings
avoid: boolean shape building: use Weld / Intersect / Trim (Curve.WeldEx) instead of rebuilding geometry from points
cards.how: Item of an IVGCrossPoints collection. PositionX / PositionY are page coordinates in document units; Offset is the position along the calling (first) path, Offset2 along the target path, expressed in the cdrSegmentOffsetType passed to GetIntersections (absolute, relative or parametric).

key_members.name: PositionX
key_members.use: horizontal coordinate of the crossing, document units

key_members.name: PositionY
key_members.use: vertical coordinate of the crossing, document units

key_members.name: Offset
key_members.use: where the crossing lies along the first path (in the requested offset type)

key_members.name: Offset2
key_members.use: where the crossing lies along the second (target) path

gotchas: All four values are read-only snapshots; they do not update when either path moves (unverified)
Offset meaning depends on the OffsetType given to GetIntersections; use the same type when feeding it to AddNodeAt / BreakApartAt (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim a As Shape, b As Shape, x As Object
Set a = ActiveSelectionRange(1): Set b = ActiveSelectionRange(2)
For Each x In a.Curve.SubPaths(1).GetIntersections(b.Curve.SubPaths(1), cdrRelativeSegmentOffset)
  Debug.Print x.PositionX, x.PositionY, x.Offset, x.Offset2
Next x

review.changes: example used undeclared shapes a / b (runtime 'Object required'); now takes the first two selected curves; 'snapshot' gotcha marked unverified

cards.name: IVGCrossPoints
cards.summary: Read-only, 1-based collection of the intersection points found between two paths by SubPath.GetIntersections or Segment.GetIntersections.
use_for: testing where two paths cross and how many times
driving node insertion or dot placement at every crossing
avoid: a plain yes/no overlap test of two whole curves: Curve.IntersectsWith is simpler
cards.how: Returned by IVGSubPath.GetIntersections(Target, OffsetType) or IVGSegment.GetIntersections(Target, OffsetType). Enumerate with For Each or index Item(1..Count).

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: Item(Index): one IVGCrossPoint, base 1 (default member)

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: For Each over the crossings

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of crossings; 0 when the paths do not meet

gotchas: Index is base 1, per the typelib
Tangent touches and overlapping collinear segments may report no point or many points (unverified)
Intersections are per subpath / segment; for multi-subpath curves loop over every SubPaths pair
cards.example:
Dim a As Shape, b As Shape, xs As Object
Set a = ActiveSelectionRange(1): Set b = ActiveSelectionRange(2)
Set xs = a.Curve.SubPaths(1).GetIntersections(b.Curve.SubPaths(1), cdrAbsoluteSegmentOffset)
If xs.Count > 0 Then Debug.Print xs(1).PositionX, xs(1).PositionY

review.changes: example used undeclared shapes a / b (runtime 'Object required'); now takes the first two selected curves

cards.name: IVGCurve
cards.summary: The editable vector geometry of a curve shape (and the display geometry of any shape): subpaths, nodes and segments, plus path math such as length, area, contour offset, weld, point-in-shape tests and node reduction. It can also live as a free curve that is on no page.
use_for: generating vector paths from data (charts, patterns, CNC / laser and vinyl-cut outlines)
offset cut lines around sticker artwork via Contour
cleaning traced artwork: AutoReduceNodes, JoinTouchingSubpaths
hit-testing points against shapes in layout scripts
avoid: primitives you will keep editing: create rectangle / ellipse shapes instead so they stay live
a contour that should stay live and editable: use the Contour effect on the shape rather than Curve.Contour
cards.how: Shape.Curve on a curve shape (Shape.ConvertToCurves first for rectangles, ellipses, text); Shape.DisplayCurve reads the drawn geometry of any shape. Build new geometry with ActiveDocument.CreateCurve plus AppendSubpath... / CreateSubPath, then place it with ActiveLayer.CreateCurve(curve). GetCopy gives a free copy; CopyAssign writes geometry back into an existing curve.

key_members.name: SubPaths
key_members.use: IVGSubPaths: each closed or open path inside the curve

key_members.name: Nodes
key_members.use: IVGNodes: every node, for node-level edits

key_members.name: Segments
key_members.use: IVGSegments: every segment (line or Bezier)

key_members.name: Closed
key_members.use: get/set whether the curve is closed

key_members.name: Length
key_members.use: total path length in document units

key_members.name: Area
key_members.use: area of a closed curve

key_members.name: CreateSubPath
key_members.use: CreateSubPath(x, y): start a new subpath, then append segments to it

key_members.name: AppendSubpathFromPoints
key_members.use: add a polyline subpath from a points array, optionally closed

key_members.name: AppendSubpathFitToPoints
key_members.use: add a smooth Bezier subpath fitted through points

key_members.name: AppendCurve
key_members.use: append all subpaths of another curve (combine)

key_members.name: GetCopy
key_members.use: free copy of the geometry, safe to modify without touching the shape

key_members.name: CopyAssign
key_members.use: replace this curve's geometry with another curve's

key_members.name: GetCurveInfo
key_members.use: low-level CurveElement array of all nodes/segments

key_members.name: PutCurveInfo
key_members.use: rebuild the curve from a CurveElement array

key_members.name: Contour
key_members.use: Contour(Offset, ...) -> new offset curve (inside/outside, end caps, corners)

key_members.name: WeldEx
key_members.use: boolean with another curve: union, intersect, subtract or xor (cdrWeldMethod)

key_members.name: IsPointInside
key_members.use: True if x,y lies inside the closed path

key_members.name: AutoReduceNodes
key_members.use: simplify the path by removing redundant nodes (0-100 amount)

key_members.name: JoinTouchingSubpaths
key_members.use: join open subpaths whose ends touch

key_members.name: ApplyTransformMatrix
key_members.use: apply a transform matrix to the geometry

gotchas: Shape.Curve only works on curve shapes; ConvertToCurves destroys a rectangle's or text's live parameters, so use DisplayCurve when you only need to read geometry
Contour, WeldEx, WeldWith, RemoveOverlaps, GetPolyline and GetCopy return a NEW free curve and leave the source unchanged; place it with ActiveLayer.CreateCurve or CopyAssign it back
Coordinates are in ActiveDocument.Unit relative to the drawing origin; set Unit explicitly at the start of a macro
A free curve (GetCopy) is not bound to a document; some operations need BindToDocument first (unverified)
GetCurveInfo / PutCurveInfo pass a SAFEARRAY of CurveElement structs, which does not marshal cleanly from Python/win32com; prefer AppendSubpathFromPoints or CreateSubPathFromArray there (unverified)
Many node edits in a loop each add an undo step; wrap them in ActiveDocument.BeginCommandGroup / EndCommandGroup
cards.example:
Dim c As Curve, s As Shape
Set c = ActiveDocument.CreateCurve
c.AppendSubpathRectangle 0, 2, 3, 0
c.AppendSubpathCircle 1.5, 1, 0.5
Set s = ActiveLayer.CreateCurve(c)
Debug.Print c.Area, c.SubPaths.Count

review.changes: none

cards.name: IVGCustomEffect
cards.summary: A custom effect (Effect.Type = cdrCustomEffect), presumably supplied by a plug-in / extension rather than one of the built-in effect types; scripts see only its EffectID string and the EffectGroup shape that holds the generated result. The typelib has no description, so what any given EffectID draws is not known from the harvest.
use_for: auditing which add-on effects a file depends on before sending it to a machine without them
finding the generated artwork group so it can be flattened or converted for output
avoid: built-in effects (blend, contour, drop shadow, envelope, extrude ...): read them through their own IVGEffect members instead
reading or editing the effect's settings: nothing beyond EffectID is exposed here
cards.how: IVGEffect.Custom on an effect whose Type is cdrCustomEffect (Shape.Effects.CustomEffects narrows the list). Such effects are created with Shape.CreateCustomEffect(EffectID, Parameters). EffectGroup is the shape holding the result (presumably shape type cdrCustomEffectGroupShape, unverified).

key_members.name: EffectID
key_members.use: read-only identifier of the add-on effect

key_members.name: EffectGroup
key_members.use: read-only IVGShape that holds the effect's generated artwork

gotchas: Valid EffectIDs and the Parameters format for CreateCustomEffect are not listed in the typelib; read EffectID from an effect applied through the UI to learn one (unverified)
Effect.Custom on a non-custom effect errors or returns Nothing; check Effect.Type = cdrCustomEffect first (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim e As Object
For Each e In ActiveShape.Effects
  If e.Type = cdrCustomEffect Then
    Debug.Print e.Custom.EffectID, e.Custom.EffectGroup.Type
  End If
Next e

review.changes: summary: plug-in provenance stated as presumed, tied to cdrCustomEffect; how: EffectGroup's cdrCustomEffectGroupShape type marked unverified

cards.name: IVGCustomShape
cards.summary: A shape whose type is presumably defined by a plug-in / extension (Shape.Type = cdrCustomShape); scripts see only its TypeID string. The typelib has no description, so which tools produce custom shapes is not known from the harvest.
use_for: inventorying add-on shape types in a file
pre-flight before export: find custom shapes an older version or another app may not render, then convert them to curves
avoid: editing the shape's parameters by script: only TypeID is exposed; read geometry via Shape.DisplayCurve
cards.how: Shape.Custom on a shape of type cdrCustomShape. Such shapes are created with ActiveLayer.CreateCustomShape(TypeID, Parameters); TypeID presumably identifies the provider of the shape type (unverified).

key_members.name: TypeID
key_members.use: read-only identifier of the custom shape type / its provider

gotchas: Valid TypeIDs and the Parameters format for CreateCustomShape are not exposed by the typelib (unverified)
ConvertToCurves freezes a custom shape into plain curves and drops its live behaviour (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim s As Shape
For Each s In ActivePage.Shapes
  If s.Type = cdrCustomShape Then Debug.Print s.Custom.TypeID
Next s

review.changes: summary / how: plug-in provenance and 'TypeID names the provider' are inference, now marked presumed / unverified

cards.name: IVGDataField
cards.summary: Definition of one Object Data field (a column of the Object Data manager): its name, data type, format string, default value, constraint, width and whether it is a default for new documents or this one.
use_for: setting up SKU / price / material fields for catalogue and signage-schedule artwork
per-object cost tallies with group summaries (SummarizeGroup)
defining the fields a data-driven labelling macro reads
avoid: document-level metadata (title, keywords, notes): use Document.Keywords / Notes / Metadata
cards.how: Item of ActiveDocument.DataFields (by index or name); created with DataFields.Add / AddEx / AddEx2. Each shape's value for the field is an IVGDataItem in Shape.ObjectData, whose DataField points back here.

key_members.name: Name
key_members.use: field name; also the key for DataFields.Item and ObjectData.Item

key_members.name: DataType
key_members.use: cdrDataType: String, Number, Event or Action

key_members.name: Format
key_members.use: display format string applied to values

key_members.name: FormatType
key_members.use: read-only cdrDataFormatType: General, DateTime, LinearAngular, Numeric

key_members.name: DefaultValue
key_members.use: value new items get

key_members.name: Constraint
key_members.use: constraint string limiting allowed values

key_members.name: FieldWidth
key_members.use: column width in the Object Data manager

key_members.name: AppDefault
key_members.use: True = field is added to new documents too

key_members.name: DocDefault
key_members.use: True = field applies by default in this document

key_members.name: SummarizeGroup
key_members.use: True = group totals summarise children's values

key_members.name: Index
key_members.use: read-only position in DataFields

key_members.name: Reorder
key_members.use: Reorder(NewIndex): move the column

key_members.name: Delete
key_members.use: remove the field definition

key_members.name: Target
key_members.use: target filter the data is meant for (export use, unverified)

key_members.name: ParentName
key_members.use: parent element name, set by AddEx2 for structured (XML-like) data (unverified)

key_members.name: ElementName
key_members.use: element name, set by AddEx2 for structured data (unverified)

gotchas: Delete removes the field and, with it, every shape's value for that field (unverified)
FormatType is read-only; it follows the Format string you set (unverified)
Renaming a field breaks macros that look values up by the old name
AppDefault = True leaks a job-specific field into every new document; keep it False for one-off schemas
cards.example:
Dim f As Object
If Not ActiveDocument.DataFields.IsPresent("SKU") Then
  Set f = ActiveDocument.DataFields.Add("SKU")
  f.DefaultValue = "TBD"
  f.AppDefault = False
End If

review.changes: summary: dropped the default field names (Name, Cost, Comments), which are not in the harvest

cards.name: IVGDataFields
cards.summary: The document's list of Object Data field definitions (the columns of the Object Data manager); add, look up and test fields here.
use_for: setting up a data schema for product sheets, signage schedules or parts lists
checking a template has the fields a macro expects
avoid: reading a shape's values: those live in Shape.ObjectData (IVGDataItems)
cards.how: ActiveDocument.DataFields. Item by 1-based index or field name; Add(Name, [Format, AppDefault, DocDefault, SummarizeGroup]) for a simple field, AddEx to also set DataType, DefaultValue, Constraint, Target and FieldWidth, AddEx2 to add parent / element names; IsPresent(FieldName) before adding.

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of defined fields

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: Item(IndexOrName): one IVGDataField (default member)

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: For Each over the fields

key_members.name: Add
key_members.use: add a field by name with optional format and default flags

key_members.name: AddEx
key_members.use: add a field with data type, default value, constraint, target and width

key_members.name: AddEx2
key_members.use: AddEx plus ParentName / ElementName for structured data

key_members.name: IsPresent
key_members.use: True if a field of that name already exists

key_members.name: Parent
key_members.use: the IVGDocument that owns the fields

gotchas: Adding a name that already exists likely errors; call IsPresent first (unverified)
Documents start with built-in fields (such as Name, Cost, Comments); leave them in shared templates (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim f As Object
For Each f In ActiveDocument.DataFields
  Debug.Print f.Index, f.Name, f.DataType
Next f
If Not ActiveDocument.DataFields.IsPresent("Price") Then ActiveDocument.DataFields.AddEx "Price", cdrDataTypeNumber, "0"

review.changes: none

cards.name: IVGDataItem
cards.summary: One shape's value for one Object Data field (for example this sign's Cost = 120); Value is the raw value, FormattedValue the text with the field's format applied.
use_for: stamping SKU / price / material on each product illustration
reading per-object data to build a parts list, quote or production schedule
driving label text from object data
avoid: text the viewer must see: object data is invisible metadata; put visible text in a text shape
cards.how: Shape.ObjectData(name or index) returns it; ObjectData.Add(DataField, Value) creates one. DataField links to the field definition (name, type, format).

key_members.name: Value
key_members.use: get/set the raw value (Variant)

key_members.name: FormattedValue
key_members.use: read-only text of the value using the field's Format

key_members.name: DataField
key_members.use: the IVGDataField this value belongs to

key_members.name: Clear
key_members.use: empty this value

key_members.name: Parent
key_members.use: the shape's IVGDataItems collection

gotchas: Value is a Variant; numbers can come back as strings depending on the field's DataType (unverified)
Object data travels with the shape through duplicate and copy/paste within CorelDRAW (unverified)
cards.example:
With ActiveShape.ObjectData("SKU")
  .Value = "BX-204"
  Debug.Print .DataField.Name, .FormattedValue
End With

review.changes: none

cards.name: IVGDataItems
cards.summary: The Object Data of one shape: the collection of its field values, one DataItem per field.
use_for: dumping every metadata value of a selected object
copying object data from a master shape onto its variants
avoid: defining new fields: that happens on ActiveDocument.DataFields; this collection only holds values
cards.how: Shape.ObjectData. Item by 1-based index or field name; Add(DataField, [Value]) attaches a value; CopyFrom(Shape) copies another shape's values; Clear wipes all of them.

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of data items on the shape

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: Item(IndexOrName): one IVGDataItem (default member)

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: For Each over the shape's values

key_members.name: Add
key_members.use: Add(DataField, [Value]) attach a value for a field

key_members.name: CopyFrom
key_members.use: CopyFrom(Shape): copy all values from another shape

key_members.name: Clear
key_members.use: remove all values from this shape

key_members.name: Parent
key_members.use: the IVGShape that owns the data

gotchas: Parent is the shape, not the document
Clear wipes every field value on the shape; use DataItem.Clear for a single field
cards.example:
Dim d As Object
For Each d In ActiveShape.ObjectData
  Debug.Print d.DataField.Name & " = " & d.FormattedValue
Next d

review.changes: none

cards.name: IVGDimension
cards.summary: Settings of a dimension-line object (from the Dimension tools): label precision, prefix / suffix, units display, boxed or centred label, placement, extension-line visibility and custom gaps; Linear or Angular holds the type-specific part.
use_for: packaging dielines and technical drawings with live measurements
signage and fabrication spec sheets
restyling every dimension label to a house style in one pass
avoid: annotation that must never change: convert to curves or use plain text
screen mock-ups where a static text label is enough
cards.how: Shape.Dimension on a dimension shape (Shape.Type = cdrLinearDimensionShape). Created with ActiveLayer.CreateLinearDimension or CreateAngularDimension using snap points as anchors. Type says which of Linear / Angular applies.

key_members.name: Type
key_members.use: read-only cdrDimensionType: Linear 0 or Angular 1

key_members.name: Linear
key_members.use: IVGDimensionLinear settings (when Type = linear)

key_members.name: Angular

cards.name: IVGDocument
cards.summary: An open CorelDRAW drawing: the top-level object for its pages, layers, selection, units, save / export / PDF publishing, undo grouping, styles, colour management, object data and review markup.
use_for: batch-producing print and web files (PDF, PNG, EPS, SVG) from templates
setting up multi-page documents and page sizes
automating layout edits that undo as one step
headless processing of many .cdr files
avoid: calling ActivePage / ActiveLayer helpers on a document that is not active: Activate it first
Export when filter options matter: use ExportEx / ExportBitmap and set options before Finish
cards.how: ActiveDocument, Application.Documents(i), or the return of Application.CreateDocument / OpenDocument. Set Unit and ReferencePoint first; work through Pages / ActivePage / ActiveLayer; wrap edits in BeginCommandGroup / EndCommandGroup so they undo as one step; output with SaveAs, ExportEx / ExportBitmap or PublishToPDF (configure PDFSettings first).

key_members.use: cdrUnit used for every position and size the script passes

key_members.name: ReferencePoint
key_members.use: anchor (centre, corner ...) for positioning and sizing calls

key_members.name: Pages

key_members.use: export to a filter, returns the filter object; call Finish to write

key_members.use: write a PDF with the current PDFSettings

key_members.use: Object Data field definitions

key_members.name: Close
key_members.use: close the document

gotchas: Unit, ReferencePoint and the drawing origin are per document and a macro inherits whatever the user left; set them first, or bracket your code with SaveSettings / RestoreSettings
ExportEx and ExportBitmap return a filter object: nothing is written until you call Finish on it
ActivePage, ActiveLayer and Selection act on the active window; call Activate before using them on another open document (unverified)
Close from a script does not ask to save; check Dirty and Save first (unverified)
Clone makes a windowless in-memory copy (IsTemporary = True); anything that needs a window or view will fail on it (unverified)

Python win32com wraps the ExportEx / ExportBitmap return as the generic ICorelExportFilter, so filter-specific properties raise AttributeError; re-wrap late-bound with win32com.client.dynamic.Dispatch (unverified)

SaveAs(path) alone fails (Python: "The Python instance can not be converted to a COM object"): pass an options object, o = app.CreateStructSaveAsOptions(); o.Overwrite = True; doc.SaveAs(path, o). The document is renamed to the saved file (plan runs 2026-10-15 (print_prep.package_for_print)).

PublishToPDF exports every page of the document, including a hidden masters page that a scene may carry (the PDF had 2 pages): set doc.PDFSettings.PublishRange = 1 to publish the current page only (plan runs 2026-10-15 (print_prep.pdfx_export)).
cards.example:
With ActiveDocument
  .Unit = cdrMillimeter
  .BeginCommandGroup "Badge"
  .ActiveLayer.CreateEllipse2 50, 50, 20
  .EndCommandGroup
  .PublishToPDF "C:\out\badge.pdf"
End With

review.changes: SaveAs key member claimed a compression option StructSaveAsOptions does not have; now lists its real fields. Summary no longer calls Document the object-model root (Application is)

cards.name: IVGDocumentEvents
cards.summary: The (hidden) event interface a CorelDRAW document fires: query-before close / save / print / export with a Cancel flag, before / after save, print and export, document open / close, and layer, page, shape and selection changes.
use_for: pre-flight checks that block a save or export (missing metadata, RGB in a print job)
auto-versioning or logging files on save and export
keeping linked data or labels in sync when shapes change
avoid: heavy work in ShapeChange or SelectionChange handlers: they fire constantly and lag the UI; run an explicit macro instead
cards.how: Not something a script calls. The Document coclass's event source is the twin dispinterface DIVGDocumentEvents (same 27 members); this dual IVGDocumentEvents is presumably what an external sink implements (unverified). In VBA, declare a WithEvents variable of type Document and write handlers named after these members; from external COM, connect a sink with ActiveDocument.AdviseEvents(sink) and disconnect it with UnadviseEvents(cookie).

key_members.name: QueryClose
key_members.use: before close; set Cancel to keep the document open

key_members.name: QuerySave
key_members.use: before save; set Cancel to stop it

key_members.name: QueryPrint
key_members.use: before print; set Cancel to stop it

key_members.name: QueryExport
key_members.use: before export; set Cancel to stop it

key_members.name: BeforeSave
key_members.use: about to save (SaveAs flag, FileName)

key_members.name: AfterSave
key_members.use: saved (SaveAs flag, FileName)

key_members.name: BeforeExport
key_members.use: about to export (FileName, Filter, SaveBitmap)

key_members.name: AfterExport
key_members.use: exported (FileName, Filter, SaveBitmap)

key_members.name: Open
key_members.use: document opened

key_members.name: Close
key_members.use: document closed

key_members.name: ShapeCreate
key_members.use: a shape was created

key_members.name: ShapeDelete
key_members.use: shapes were deleted (Count only)

key_members.name: ShapeChange
key_members.use: a shape changed; Scope flags fill, outline, transparency, content, text ...

key_members.name: ShapeTransform
key_members.use: a shape was transformed

key_members.name: SelectionChange
key_members.use: the selection changed

key_members.name: PageCreate
key_members.use: a page was added

key_members.name: LayerCreate
key_members.use: a layer was added

gotchas: Hidden interface (typelib flag hidden): object browsers do not list it by default; handler names and parameter lists must match these members exactly
Delete events (ShapeDelete, PageDelete, LayerDelete) pass only a Count, not the deleted objects
ShapeChange's Scope is a bit set of cdrShapeChangeScope values; test with And, not =
Cancel in the Query... events is meant to be set True to block the action (by-reference argument) (unverified)
Keep the cookie from AdviseEvents and call UnadviseEvents, or the sink stays connected to the document (unverified)
No event fires while Application.EventsEnabled is False; a macro that turned it off for speed must turn it back on
cards.example:
Private WithEvents doc As Document
Sub Hook()
  Set doc = ActiveDocument
End Sub
Private Sub doc_BeforeExport(ByVal FileName As String, ByVal Filter As cdrFilter, ByVal SaveBitmap As Boolean)
  If Len(doc.Keywords) = 0 Then MsgBox "Add keywords before exporting"
End Sub

review.changes: how: the typelib's Document coclass sources DIVGDocumentEvents, not this dual interface; said so. Added the Application.EventsEnabled gotcha

cards.name: IVGDocuments
cards.summary: The collection of drawings open in CorelDRAW (Application.Documents): count, index and enumerate them.
use_for: saving or exporting every open file in a batch
finding an already-open file before opening it again
avoid: opening or creating documents here: use Application.OpenDocument / CreateDocument
cards.how: Application.Documents (or the global Documents in VBA). Item takes a 1-based number; loop and compare FullFileName or Title to find a file.

key_members.use: Item(Index): one IVGDocument, base 1 (default member)

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: For Each over open documents

key_members.use: number of open documents

key_members.name: Application
key_members.use: the CorelDRAW application

key_members.name: Parent
key_members.use: the application (same as Application)

cards.name: IVGDuotone
cards.summary: Duotone settings of a bitmap: monotone / duotone / tritone / quadtone type, the tone inks with their tone curves, and optional overprint colour overrides; loadable from and savable to a .cpd file.
